title: 🛑 STOP STEALING YOUR OWN PEACE.
paragraphs: When thinking about life, remember this: No amount of guilt can solve the past, and no amount of anxiety can change the future. 🕰️⛓️

The enemy attacks you with Guilt to keep you stuck in yesterday, and Anxiety to keep you paralyzed by tomorrow. Why? Because if he can keep your mind in the past or the future, he steals your power in the PRESENT.
Guilt is a heavy backpack from a trip you are no longer on. Anxiety is paying interest on a debt you may never owe.
Drop the weight. God is named "I AM"—not "I WAS" or "I WILL BE." He meets you in the now. Trust Him with your history and your destiny so you can actually live today.
"Can any one of you by worrying add a single hour to your life?" — Matthew 6:27 (NIV)
Your Move: Type "I CHOOSE PEACE" if you are putting down the heavy baggage today! 🕊️🎒
